text:
sqlpipe moves table rows from Postgres to S3. The tool runs three processes: a reader, a converter, and an uploader.

The reader opens a connection to Postgres and streams rows in batches. Each batch holds a fixed number of rows. The reader sends each batch to the converter.

The converter turns each batch into one Parquet row group. The converter collects the row groups into a Parquet file in memory. When the file reaches the target size, the converter sends the file to the uploader.

The uploader writes each file to S3 as a multipart upload. Each part is one HTTP request. If a part fails, the uploader sends that part again. The uploader repeats a part five times. After five failures, the uploader stops the upload and reports the error.
